title: Verify a reached breakpoint in a typed recipe
platforms: Windows GNU under Wine/Xvfb, isolated EUR interpreter
changes: Verify the bounded search hit path, hit assertion, following step and explicit resume in an actual isolated session.
validation: A Thumb PC breakpoint hit before the eligible instruction after 40948 interpreter steps; its hit assertion passed, the next step completed one frame and the checkpoint recorded both. A second resume preserved guest state, protected inputs stayed unchanged and the GUI closed normally.
limitations: One EUR Wine interpreter hit only; feature-gated watchpoint, native Windows and physical input remain unverified. The private session copy is retained as the current proof.
